zh-CN.summary: 无头 Chrome 沙箱，供 OpenClaw 或其他服务通过 DevTools 协议操作。

zh-TW.summary: 無頭 Chrome 沙箱，讓 OpenClaw 或其他服務透過 DevTools 協定操作。

metadata.name: OpenClaw Browser Sandbox
metadata.summary: A headless Chrome that OpenClaw or other services drive through the DevTools protocol.

zh-CN.summary: 这是给单个所有者用的私人浏览器。它不用 root 权限运行，文件系统只读，没有额外权限，也没有 API 令牌。只有带它的客户端标签的 Pod 连得进来。向外的网络流量没有限制。上游把 Chromium 内置的渲染沙箱关掉了，所以恶意网页可以接管浏览器 Pod。

zh-TW.summary: 這是給單一擁有者用的私人瀏覽器。它不用 root 權限執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有額外權限，也沒有 API 權杖。只有帶它的用戶端標籤的 Pod 連得進來。往外的網路流量沒有限制。上游把 Chromium 內建的渲染沙箱關掉了，所以惡意網頁可以接管瀏覽器 Pod。

zh-CN.mitigation: 说明里已写明只给单个所有者使用。Pod 里没有应用或供应商的凭证，没有挂载主机目录，也没有 Kubernetes 令牌。文件系统只读，状态只临时保存，身份权限受限，资源也有上限。除非你另外加上 egress NetworkPolicy，否则浏览器还是能打开内网和云端 metadata 地址。不要让互不信任的人共用同一个浏览器。
zh-CN.risk: 恶意网页可以接管没有沙箱保护的 Chromium 进程。攻击者就能拿到这个 Pod 的完整身份和浏览器的会话数据。

zh-TW.mitigation: 說明裡已寫明只給單一擁有者使用。Pod 裡沒有應用程式或供應商的認證資訊，沒有掛載主機目錄，也沒有 Kubernetes 權杖。檔案系統唯讀，狀態只暫存，身分權限受限，資源也有上限。除非你另外加上 egress NetworkPolicy，否則瀏覽器還是能開啟內網和雲端 metadata 位址。不要讓互不信任的人共用同一個瀏覽器。
zh-TW.risk: 惡意網頁可以接管沒有沙箱保護的 Chromium 程序。攻擊者就能拿到這個 Pod 的完整身分和瀏覽器的工作階段資料。

risks.mitigation: The description says to use it for a single owner. The pod holds no application or provider credentials, no host mounts and no Kubernetes token. Its filesystem is read-only, its state is temporary, its identity is restricted and its resources are limited. The browser can still open private and cloud metadata addresses unless you add an egress NetworkPolicy. Do not share one browser between users who do not trust each other.
risks.risk: A malicious web page can take over the Chromium process, which has no sandbox. The attacker then gets the pod's full identity and the browser session data.

zh-CN.mitigation: 没有对外的 Ingress 或 LoadBalancer。NetworkPolicy 只放行同一个命名空间里、带有标签 templates.zeabur.com/openclaw-browser-sandbox-client=true 的 Pod，而且只开 9222 端口。OpenClaw 模板会加上这个标签。能在该命名空间创建 Pod 或改标签的人都视为可信任。浏览器只以无头模式运行，VNC 和 noVNC 都已关闭。
zh-CN.risk: CDP 端口可以完全控制浏览器，而前面的代理不会检查任何密码。

zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有對外的 Ingress 或 LoadBalancer。NetworkPolicy 只放行同一個命名空間裡、帶有標籤 templates.zeabur.com/openclaw-browser-sandbox-client=true 的 Pod，而且只開 9222 連接埠。OpenClaw 模板會加上這個標籤。能在該命名空間建立 Pod 或改標籤的人都視為可信任。瀏覽器只以無頭模式執行，VNC 和 noVNC 都已關閉。
zh-TW.risk: CDP 連接埠可以完全控制瀏覽器，而前面的代理不會檢查任何密碼。

risks.mitigation: There is no public Ingress or LoadBalancer. A NetworkPolicy lets in only Pods in the same namespace with the label templates.zeabur.com/openclaw-browser-sandbox-client=true, and only on port 9222. The OpenClaw template sets this label. Anyone who can write pods or labels in that namespace is trusted. The browser runs headless only, and VNC and noVNC are turned off.
risks.risk: The CDP port gives full control of the browser, and the proxy in front of it checks no password.

security.summary: This is a private browser for one owner. It runs without root rights, with a read-only filesystem, no extra privileges and no API token. Only Pods with its client label can reach it. Outbound traffic is not limited. Upstream turns off Chromium's built-in renderer sandbox, so a hostile web page can take over the browser pod.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: openclaw-browser-sandbox
        app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
        image: ghcr.io/canyugs/openclaw-sandbox-browser:edcc8e5@sha256:e6fcd2cb4272498709d16ad6a12526363559ed5846eb2ff0f775f15d62365ef7
        ports:
        - name: cdp
          containerPort: 9222
        env:
        - name: OPENCLAW_BROWSER_CDP_PORT
          value: '9222'
        - name: OPENCLAW_BROWSER_HEADLESS
          value: '1'
        - name: OPENCLAW_BROWSER_ENABLE_NOVNC
          value: '0'
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: shm
          mountPath: /dev/shm
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: cdp
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: cdp
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: cdp
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 60
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      - name: shm
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: openclaw-sandbox-browser-allow
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser-allow
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: openclaw-browser-sandbox
      app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          templates.zeabur.com/openclaw-browser-sandbox-client: 'true'
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9222
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-sandbox-browser
  ports:
  - name: cdp
    port: 9222
    targetPort: cdp
